description: This file defines a PHP class named 'component' that implements a connector interface for integrating external data sources with SugarCRM / SuiteCRM. It contains methods for initializing, mapping input/output, loading and saving configuration, and interacting with SugarBeans.

classes.name: component
classes.description: Represents a connector component class that manages data transfer and mapping between external sources and SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the component class, currently does nothing.

methods.name: fillBean
methods.description: Retrieves an item from the external source and loads it into a SugarBean instance after mapping fields.

methods.name: fillBeans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of items from the external source, loads them into an array of SugarBeans, with support for field mapping and options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Placeholder for persisting a SugarBean to the external source.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration array from the data source.

methods.name: getFieldDefs
methods.description: Retrieves field definitions from the source.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the data source.

methods.name: mapInput
methods.description: Maps input data fields to the format expected by the external data source.

methods.name: mapOutput
methods.description: Maps data from the external source to the fields of a SugarBean based on configuration.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves and processes a specific field value from the result based on field definitions and possible functions.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Persists the current configuration to storage.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the current field mapping configuration.

methods.name: getModuleMapping
methods.description: Returns mapping specific to a module.

methods.name: getModuleFieldDef
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition for a specified module and field.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the current data source object.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the data source object for this component.
